name: Sándorfalva (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Sándorfalva: a quartered blue and yellow shield with a bird, a lion and a plough, with a helm, a crest and blue and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sándorfalva arms with helm, crest and mantling
